desc: Clean tiled shower-wall access view with the trim removed, a generic brass valve body and cartridge seated straight in the opening, and a plain cartridge-puller tool staged on a folded cloth.
reuse_notes: Use for shower-valve cartridge access, bathroom plumbing diagnosis, trim removal context, and controlled repair-planning articles.
